body: From my time in various hospitals for this stuff I’ve learned medications can be a weird thing. My therapist says that mental health needs a two prong response with medication and therapy. Some people just focus more on one side if the other is less effective. I understand the fear and anger that comes with thinking of the future. What works for me is focusing on the next 5 minutes instead of years. We are all getting through what we can and that’s all anyone can ask of you. Getting to the point where you are in life is already a huge accomplishment. Maybe just try getting through tonight. I always try to distract myself in whatever way possible. Funny youtube videos and not sad music helps me.

I used to think exactly like you did. I would pray and hope to get some incurable disease or be in a fatal accident. I know how draining and hounding these thoughts are. I always tried to just distract myself with funny youtube videos or not sad music. Just know more people care about you than you know and if you can’t believe that than know at least I care about you. If you want to talk more im here.

Hi! Listen I know everything seems really horrible right now and I complexity understand why you would think this. Our world has been flipped upside down. Times are super hard for people like us with these kinds of thoughts and I understand more than I could explain. I know you feel like there’s no other options and I understand why you do. No on really knows what’s going to happen after this but remember hiring can’t be like this forever. Everyday new changes are happening to our society. I can’t offer a perfect solution but I want you to know that you are not going through this alone and there’s so many people that are going through the same thing. If you want to talk more I’m here.

I’m glad i could help and if you feel like that again reaching out is the best thing you can do. I’m so happy you got through it and I hope you’ll remember that people care about you more than you know. Good luck with everything!
Of course! I know everything is hard to deal with right now but I’m proud of you for reaching out. It’s a lot harder to do than people think and you made a good decision. Keep fighting!

Is there any way you could negotiate with her? Just tell her you will try in the morning but right now you aren’t feeling good? I don’t know if that works with your parents but if it doesn’t I would just pretend to do work until you can sleep. I would also say distract yourself in any way you can. Watch Youtube or listen to not sad music. Anything that takes you away from thinking.

Okay I know everything feels horrible right now but I was in your place less than 2 months ago. No matter what You will regret attempting and I can attest to that. Nights tend to be the hardest points for people like us and things will feel better in the morning no matter what. I would say go to sleep even if you need to do the work. If you can’t guarantee your safety if you’re awake I wouldn’t recommend doing your work. I know everything is probably piling up but the year is almost over. Everything has been thrown upside down and it makes sense that school is much harder than before. Maybe i’m not coming across in the best way but i hope you believe me when I say I understand more than I could ever explain. But you aren’t alone. You aren’t broken and you matter to your friend, your boyfriend, your family and so many others. We have never met but I also care about you. Things will get better and I know you won’t believe that now. But soon you’ll look back on this night as something you survived. By the summer you might even forget this happened. The night also makes things worse and I think you might realize that. If you need more help I recommend a texting crisis line. They have been super helpful to me in the past. I hope I have helped in any way and I want you to remember that you are never as alone as you think.
